records.title: Computable randomness under finite-ambiguity observations
records.provisional_shape: For every k>=1 let F_k be all total computable fair-coin-preserving Cantor self-maps with at most k preimages of each point. R_fin(x) means x is computably random and F(x) is computably random for every k and F in F_k. Ask whether R_fin equals CR and, if not, for a natural characterization. No effective inverse branches are assumed.
records.motivation: Does bounded ambiguity of an observation explain stability beyond effective isomorphisms?
records.structural_difference: Restricts map fibres while keeping the ordinary computable-martingale observer; no distinct class is asserted.
records.prospective_value: Preservation or exact failure criterion, with a test characterization if a substantive class arises.
records.collapse_risk: HIGH: may preserve CR outright or be covered by established map theory.
falsifiers: Already a routine instance of a recorded/source theorem
A known preservation class with no additional explanatory theorem
No substantive role for the finite-ambiguity restriction
dependencies: Effective inverse information versus cardinal fibre bounds
source_evidence_weaknesses: Catalogue does not evaluate bounded-fibre total maps; absence is not novelty evidence
Do not import an a.e.-map theorem into a total-map witness claim

formulation_alignment.map_scope: CAND-01 keeps everywhere-total computable fair-coin-preserving Cantor self-maps. This is narrower in domain-totality than SRC-0015's a.e.-computable map convention, but no forward computable-randomness conservation theorem is inferred from that syntactic inclusion.
formulation_alignment.fibre_scope: For each fixed k>=1 the candidate requires the global cardinal condition |F^{-1}(y)|<=k for every y. This is retained as a set-theoretic fibre restriction. The candidate assumes no effective enumeration, selector or inverse branches for those fibres.
formulation_alignment.inverse_and_preimage_scope: THM-0038 assumes an a.e.-computable inverse pair with inverse identities almost everywhere; CAND-01 does not assume that data. THM-0037 instead concludes existence of at least one computably random preimage of a computably random output under an a.e.-computable map. That existential reverse-direction conclusion is not forward preservation of computable randomness.
formulation_alignment.maximality_guard: THM-0008 and THM-0039 concern Martin-Löf randomness and closure under conservation plus no-randomness-from-nothing. They do not supply a finite-to-one computable-randomness preservation theorem for CAND-01.
formulation_alignment.evidence: The committed catalogue was sufficient. SRC-0011/SRC-0015 are already STATEMENT_INSPECTED and the exact hypotheses are recorded in DEF-0035/DEF-0036 and THM-0035/THM-0037/THM-0038/THM-0008/THM-0039. No source passage was reopened and no access level changed.
formulation_alignment.conclusion: The exact CAND-01 formulation is not disposed of by the recorded map/isomorphism/preimage theorems. Retain it provisionally with shape unchanged and mark E1 resolved. This is not evidence of novelty, openness, separation or nontriviality, and no finite-to-one preservation theorem is asserted.

records.title: Nonergodic convergence for enumerable events
records.object: individual sequence; dynamics and effectively open events
records.provisional_shape: B_open(x) means that for every total computable fair-coin-preserving Cantor self-map T and every effectively open U, the averages (1/N) sum_{i<N} 1_U(T^i x) converge. No ergodicity, expectation equality, computable event measure or convergence modulus is required. Ask for its exact randomness characterization.
records.motivation: Identify the randomness needed for convergent frequencies of positively recognizable binary events in nonergodic dynamics.
records.structural_difference: Changes the observable from computable to enumerable-event indicators; boundedness isolates recognition from integrability-tail issues.
records.prospective_value: Exact test characterization or substantive obstruction; explain the relation to the larger lower-semicomputable observable class.
records.collapse_risk: HIGH: familiar endpoint, existing characterization, or a transformation-convention artifact.
falsifiers: Exact source already characterizes this same map/observable class
Apparent gap is solely total versus a.e. maps or convergence versus expectation
No substantive characterization beyond existing endpoints
source_evidence_weaknesses: SRC-0058 total versus a.e. transformation convention requires local alignment before applying its converse
The absent indicator converse in this bounded catalogue is not an open-problem claim

formulation_alignment.transformation_scope: CAND-02 keeps everywhere-total computable fair-coin-preserving Cantor self-maps. SRC-0058's computable-transformation representation guarantees the induced transformation is defined and infinite outside a computable G_delta null set; its Section 4 converse construction explicitly ensures definition almost everywhere, not everywhere totality.
formulation_alignment.observable_scope: CAND-02 keeps indicators of effectively open sets. These are bounded lower-semicomputable observables, so they sit inside the lower-semicomputable observable convention used for THM-0064 without importing unbounded/integrability-tail issues. THM-0063's converse witness uses a computable set/indicator, but its transformation is only source-a.e.-defined.
formulation_alignment.nonergodic_guard: CAND-02 requires convergence only. No equality with lambda(U) is required. THM-0059/THM-0060 identify the limit with the expectation only under ergodicity and are retained solely as that guard.
formulation_alignment.evidence: SRC-0058 was locally reinspected at the smallest blocking passages in the already-catalogued arXiv copy: Definition 1.4, Section 2 transformation representation, Section 4 converse construction, and Section 5 lower-semicomputable theorem. SRC-0057 did not require renewed external access because its exact ergodic hypotheses were already statement-inspected in the catalogue.
formulation_alignment.conclusion: The exact CAND-02 predicate is not disposed of by THM-0063 because the source converse witness is not established everywhere total. THM-0064 remains a sufficient-condition benchmark, not a characterization of the candidate predicate. No converse, separation, novelty or literature-openness claim is made.

records.title: Oracle lowness for uniform computable randomness
records.object: oracle class, not a sampled-sequence randomness class
records.provisional_shape: L_u consists of those A such that every computably random X is computably random uniformly relative to A in DEF-0025. Uniform families must be total and valid on every oracle instance. Ask for an intrinsic characterization and comparison with computable oracles and K-triviality, without asserting any answer.
records.motivation: Determine whether the known pairwise ordinary/uniform relativization distinction survives universal preservation over random inputs.
records.structural_difference: Universal lowness with globally total uniform families; neither ordinary lowness nor existential baseness by definition.
records.prospective_value: Independent oracle characterization with a concrete randomness or product-information consequence.
records.collapse_risk: HIGH: universal quantification may erase the distinction; a standard lowness class may already characterize it.
falsifiers: Established lowness class with its existing characterization
Routine reduction to ordinary computable lowness
No meaningful consequence for randomness beyond renaming an oracle property
source_evidence_weaknesses: Broader uniform-lowness and traceability literature was deliberately not catalogued
THM-0025 supplies an existential pair only, not a noncomputable member of L_u
SRC-0009 Theorem 5.7 is a statement-inspected source-record contrast, not a separate THM node

records.title: Largest class with unrestricted conservation and random preimages
records.object: largest class of fair-coin Cantor points
records.provisional_shape: Largest R such that every a.e.-computable fair-coin-preserving self-map F is defined on R, sends R into R, and every y in R has a preimage in R.
records.motivation: Axiomatize randomness by information-processing and preimage principles.
records.structural_difference: None at this exact maximality level: THM-0008 already identifies MLR.
records.prospective_value: The desired characterization is already catalogued.
falsifiers: THM-0008 exactly disposes of the proposed maximal class; it does not classify all smaller closed classes
source_evidence_weaknesses: Earliest standalone ML-NRFN provenance remains unresolved but is not needed for this modern theorem

records.title: Hierarchy from additional finite differences
records.object: individual sequence; fixed finite test difference depth
records.provisional_shape: For a fixed n>=3, pass every neighbourhood-based n-r.e. test of SRC-0035 Definition 2.3 with recursive indices and level measure <=2^-i, and ask if n>2 creates distinct classes.
records.motivation: Test whether additional finite alternations increase observational power.
records.structural_difference: THM-0026 already collapses all these n>=2 levels to difference randomness.
records.prospective_value: The hoped-for hierarchy is already ruled out in the catalogue.
falsifiers: THM-0026; switching to naive string tests changes the convention and does not rescue this shape
source_evidence_weaknesses: No central weak-access dependency; rejection uses statement-inspected SRC-0035

records.title: Mutual uniform randomness of the two halves
records.provisional_shape: X=A interleaved with B, with A uniformly computably random relative to B and B uniformly computably random relative to A.
records.motivation: Express symmetric resistance to prediction from the other component.
records.structural_difference: THM-0024 already identifies exactly computable randomness of the interleaving.
records.prospective_value: The desired two-sided characterization is already catalogued.
falsifiers: THM-0024; dropping one side is a changed question, not a restatement of the source
dependencies: Uniform versus ordinary relative computable randomness
source_evidence_weaknesses: No central weak-access dependency; rejection uses statement-inspected SRC-0032
